design.purpose: A flat six-point snowflake decoration for one person to display in a window.

steps.c: Place the paper and scissors on the table.
Fold the top-right corner onto the bottom-left corner.
Fold the top-left corner onto the bottom-right corner.
Fold the top-right edge through the top point.
Fold the top-left edge through the top point.
Cut straight across the wedge wide end.
Cut a triangular notch from the left edge.
Cut a triangular notch from the right edge.
Cut a small notch across the pointed tip.
Open the sheet out flat to reveal the pattern.
